Overview

The Sainik School Nagrota, a residential school in Jammu and Kashmir, has issued Advt No. EN 31/61 for the 2026 recruitment cycle. The notification invites applications for three positions: one TGT (Computer Science), one Art Master, and one Nursing Sister (Female). A total of 3 vacancies are available.

Eligibility and Pay

TGT (Computer Science) – Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Application (BCA) with at least 50 % marks or a graduation in Computer Science/IT with 50 % marks, and possess a B.Ed (or an integrated B.Ed‑M.Ed or a four‑year integrated degree with 50 % marks). They must also be qualified in CTET‑II or STET. The pay is governed by Pay Matrix Level‑7, ranging from Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 per month.

Art Master – Applicants need a Master’s degree in Fine Arts (Painting specialization) or a graduate qualification with Fine Arts/Art/Drawing and Painting, complemented by a minimum of 4 years diploma or 5 years (full‑time) / 7 years (part‑time) diploma in Fine Art. The salary is a consolidated Rs. 35,000 per month.

Nursing Sister (Female) – Requires a B.Sc. (Nursing) or Nursing Diploma from a recognized institute, registration with the Indian or State Nursing Council, and at least 2 years of experience in a hospital or clinic. The pay is a consolidated Rs. 25,500 per month.

Additional desirable qualifications mentioned in the notice include post‑graduate degrees, computer courses in networking, IT, AI & Machine Learning, experience teaching in English‑medium residential schools, proficiency in games, sports or other outdoor activities, and talents in music, public speaking or fine arts.

Application Process

Applications must be submitted offline – either by post or in person – and must reach the school by 20 November 2026. The advertisement states that no application fee is required. Candidates should fill the application form (available on the school’s website www.sainikschoolnagrota.com) and send it to the address specified in the notification.

Age Limits

  • TGT (Computer Science): 21 – 35 years
  • Art Master: 21 – 35 years
  • Nursing Sister (Female): 18 – 50 years

Age is calculated on the last date of receipt of application.

Terms of Engagement

The initial contract period is one year (11 serving months plus a one‑month break). This period can be extended annually up to a maximum of three years. Contractual staff have no claim to regular appointment after the contract expires.

How to Verify and Apply

The official notification PDF can be accessed through the Important Links section of the advertisement (link not reproduced here). Applicants are advised to read the full PDF before applying to confirm all conditions. The school’s website also hosts the application form, but candidates should verify the URL against the official document.

  • Last date to apply: Applications must be received by 20 November 2026.
  • Number of vacancies: 3 (1 TGT, 1 Art Master, 1 Nursing Sister).
  • How to apply: Submit a completed offline application to the address in the notification; ensure it arrives by the deadline.
  • Age limit: Varies by post (see table above).
  • Salary: TGT – Rs. 44,900‑1,42,400 (Pay Matrix Level‑7); Art Master – Rs. 35,000 per month; Nursing Sister – Rs. 25,500 per month.
  • Qualification: BCA/B.Sc. (Computer Science) with B.Ed and CTET‑II/STET for TGT; Master’s in Fine Arts or equivalent for Art Master; B.Sc. (Nursing) or Diploma with registration and 2 years experience for Nursing Sister.
  • Who cannot apply: Any application received after the stipulated deadline will be rejected.
  • Terms of engagement: One‑year initial period, extendable annually up to three years; no claim to regular post.
